sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Block analytics & tracking
Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Disable auto-updates
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Hide device identifiers
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Hide VPN connection
Hides an active VPN from the app's checks on the phone.
Mask live ad breaks
Covers live ad breaks with a "We'll be right back!" screen and mutes them.
Report Wi-Fi connection
Makes the app see a Wi-Fi connection when the phone is on mobile data.
Skip ads
Removes the ads, ad markers, and pause ads from on-demand videos.
Skip launch video
Opens the app with the static logo instead of the branded intro video.
Spoof carrier
Hides your mobile carrier from the app, or reports a carrier name you choose.
